title: Phase-answer derivation's inputs cannot produce its declared output
description: SA question merged with the primer-audit snapshot refinement: the process-integrity report needs handle resolution (filesystem and git IO), milestone state, and chassis compaction counts — none in the (state artifact, tracker snapshot) tuple. Fix: define the snapshot as an explicitly-acquired materialized view (acquisition in the effectful shell, the named clock-as-parameter refinement) and reassign the checks that cannot be materialized to the shell.
